title: Representing and Using Knowledge with the Contextual Evaluation Model
reasoning: Section 6, 'Motivation: The Good and the Bad', introduces `p+` and `p-` points to represent good/pleasure and bad/pain. It explicitly discusses the philosophical implications of these points, referencing concepts like 'qualia' and 'philosophical zombies', and the role of 'emotions' in AI, which are directly related to ethical considerations regarding AI consciousness and well-being. This is a core design component of the model, not just a brief discussion.
